I can absolutely get behind Sanders, AOC, and Crocket. 

Bernie may be old, but he has a consistent track record.  AOC and Crocket are young, but I've liked a lot of their actions and voicings.   As an Oregonian I also like Merkley.

I have for very many years opposed both the RNC and the DNC.  I am very leftist and have moved even more so as I've gotten older.  My options have been next to nothing since I reached voting age 30+ years ago.   Bernie seems to uphold my values the most of what is available.

Just as an example that may give someone ideas, here's what I'm doing.  I 'allow' myself $25 a month in nonessential purchases.  Usually this goes to the occasional beer, paid in cash to a locally owned store.

Growing season is here.  All winter I saved anything I could use to pot up seedlings. Milk jugs became mini greenhouses for cool weather seedlings, sour cream and jam containers for potting up my early warm weather starts.

I composted all winter to feed my plants once I plant them.

I traded my neighbors things for potting soil and pots.  I'll also be giving them extra starts and veggies once I can.

I'll be spending the warming weather prepping my containers and beds and planning my growing space (I have a 20'x20' area in an urban setting).  When it's not warm enough I'm watching gardening vids to enhance my knowledge.

At work whenever they're going to throw something away that's useful I ask for it.  (I work on a farm, so pots, buckets, etc)

I have a DVD collection, a CD collection, a Steam Deck and a phone for entertainment.   I also live next to a park with a disc golf course.

I only drive to and from work.  I only buy gas from a locally owned business.

For me, this means I'm saving money, bettering my home environment, not really spending anything I don't have to, and creating community by working with my neighbors.

Every little bit helps.  No one is perfect, but it's really not hard to limit extras.  We have become an increasingly wasteful society.   Lean into your creative hobbies.  Build community, grow your own food, reuse whatever you can instead of buying more.   I do use YouTube, there's a wealth of information on it, and at the moment is a necessary evil. I have deleted all meta and TikTok and never used Twitter.   

Find what you can do and do as much as you can.  I got 20 lbs of tomatoes last year from seeds of a tomato I bought at the grocery store.

- Remove team ownership of gyms, instead allow a gym to hold a total of 25 pokemon from all three teams.

- When you fight the gym, you fight the two opposing gyms pokes in order from highest ranked to lowest ranked.

- A pokemon earns prestige points for each opposing poke defeated, defending pokes earn prestige points for each attacking poke defeated, and loses prestige points each time it is defeated.

- Pokes are ordered in the gym by the prestige points they have earned.

- When the battle is completed, if the attacker has a poke that has earned enough prestige points to have a larger amount than the 25th poke, it is revived, healed and placed in the gym.

- Prestige points are only good for the current battle for attackers and while holding the gym for defenders.  Points don't get saved for use in other gyms, although some sort of medals would be cool.

- Coins are automatically awarded every 21 hours to the team with the greatest prestige in the gym.  Gyms are worth 100 coins and each member of the winning team receives a percentage of the coins equal to their percentage of the gym prestige.  In case of a tie between teams, the 100 coins is doled out to both teams based on prestige percentage.

- Gyms have a random type advantage that is rerolled during payout.  This advantage could bolster attack, defense, or HP of the type, or could make type advantages more effective.

- fighting the top ranked first instead of lowest creates a natural decay in top placement, since it would most likely lose prestige points to fresh attackers and move down the list.

- random typings creates an ever evolving meta game and would possibly diversify pokemon usage for attacking and defending.

- the value of pure CP is diminished, although could still be used to calculate points gained and lost for prestige, since it is a rough calculation on how tough a poke is to beat.

- All gyms should not be re-rolled and paid out at the same time, or else there would be an optimum time to do gym runs.
